exposure: Rectus muscle re-approximation (RMR) during cesarean section
outcome: Postoperative pain (VAS score at 24 and 48 hours)
cohort: 279 primiparous women undergoing elective singleton cesarean section at term
finding: Rectus muscle re-approximation (RMR) during cesarean section did not significantly affect postoperative pain, operation time, analgesic use, hospital stay, or the occurrence of adverse postoperative events.
